title: Part-time Customer Service Manager
description:
**Customer Services Manager**

Total Compensation including salary, bonus, commission & benefits: 3.4L - 4.7L per year

This position sits at the heart of our growing global organisation, you will be responsible for all aspects of your centre’s performance. We’ll give you the autonomy and resource to manage your centre as though it’s your own business. You will have a wide range of responsibilities including:

* Being responsible for managing anything and everything on site.
* Rising to every challenge and solving problems.
* Giving tours to prospective customers.
* Upselling to existing customers.
* Above all, looking after our customers so well that each becomes a brand ambassador – for you, your team and IWG.

**What we can do for you**

You’re reading the right advert if you’re looking for:

* a fun, challenging and rewarding career.
* great induction training and excellent ongoing learning and development.
* fantastic promotion prospects.
* generous, achievable incentives and sociable hours.
* access to a comprehensive range of flexible, personalised workplace benefits that support mental, physical and financial wellbeing.

**About you**

Ideally, you’ll have some experience of delivering against targets when leading a small, close-knit team. You may have run a flexible workspace centre before, or else a store, restaurant or any site with a high degree of customer focus. Alongside your natural sales and commercial skills, what matters most is that you’ve got the right mindset: passion, drive, ownership and resilience.

* **Passion**: looking after our diverse prospects, customers and guests is at the heart of what we do, so you must bring your passion and positivity to work every day.
* **Drive**: your own and your team’s collective drive for success means you’ll only relax once you’ve delivered the results you’re looking for.
* **Resilience**: a relentless focus on business priorities, regardless of any obstacles placed in front of you.

Above all, you’ll be key to ensuring all our customers only ever receive a truly world-class service.

And your sense of **ownership** means you’ll continuously ensure the quality of service and the workspace are as good as they possibly can be.

**About IWG**

With almost 4,000 tech-enabled, sustainable and inspiring centres across the world, we’re already four times the scale of our nearest competitor – and we’re continuing to grow.

With 80% of the Fortune 500 already among our customers, and plans to expand to 30,000+ centres over the next decade, we’re uniquely placed to offer the right person exciting career opportunities as we continue pioneering the workspaces of tomorrow.

We know we can only succeed if we give all our people every opportunity to shine. That’s why so many of our most senior leaders started their careers in our centres.

We’re also proud of reducing commuting-related carbon emissions by getting workers out of their cars and onto their bikes and their feet. Alongside our investments in advanced buildings, this supports our commitment to be carbon neutral – which we achieved in 2023.

So don’t hesitate. Apply today – and let’s work together to help millions of people have a great day at work.

title: Assistant Manager - Referral & Alternative Sourcing
description:
1. Role Objective

To drive business sourcing, qualified lead generation, site visits, and bookings through Customer Referrals, Loyalty Programs, Employee Referrals, Corporate Associations, Outstation and NRI initiatives, and other alternative sourcing channels. The role is responsible for developing sustainable sourcing programs, achieving assigned business targets, improving conversion efficiency, and ensuring cost-effective execution in alignment with the organization's business plan.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Business Planning & Sourcing Strategy

1. Develop and implement sourcing plans for new project launches and sustenance business through Referral, Loyalty, Employee, Corporate, Outstation, NRI, and Alternative Sourcing channels.

2. Plan and achieve a minimum of 50% of the overall business plan through designated non-marketing-led sourcing channels, with the balance 50% attributed to marketing-led sourcing, as per the approved business plan.

3. Work closely with the Brand & Marketing Head to establish monthly, quarterly, and annual sourcing targets for each channel.

4. Develop long-term sourcing strategies and scalable programs to ensure consistent business contribution across projects.

5. Identify new sourcing opportunities, assess their potential, and recommend initiatives to strengthen lead generation and business conversion.

B. Referral & Loyalty Program Management

1. Develop and execute customer referral and loyalty programs to generate qualified leads, site visits, and bookings.

2. Design structured referral initiatives to encourage existing customers to recommend the organization's projects to prospective buyers.

3. Coordinate with the Brand & Marketing Head to develop referral benefits, customer engagement initiatives, and loyalty program structures.

4. Monitor referral lead quality, customer engagement, conversion rates, and program effectiveness.

5. Identify opportunities to increase repeat business, customer advocacy, and referrals across existing projects.

C. Employee & Corporate Sourcing

1. Develop and implement employee referral programs to generate qualified prospects through the organization's internal network.

2. Establish and strengthen corporate sourcing initiatives through associations with IT companies, manufacturing companies, institutions, and other relevant organizations.

3. Plan and execute corporate engagement activities, employee outreach programs, and targeted property awareness initiatives.

4. Work with internal stakeholders to communicate project offerings and approved employee or corporate benefits.

5. Track lead generation, site visits, bookings, and business contribution from employee and corporate sourcing initiatives.

D. Outstation, NRI & Alternative Sourcing

1. Develop targeted sourcing strategies to generate business from outstation customers, NRIs, and other relevant customer segments.

2. Identify suitable markets, customer groups, and engagement opportunities to expand the organization's sourcing footprint.

3. Coordinate with the Marketing and Sales Teams to execute targeted outreach programs, customer engagement initiatives, and project presentation activities.

4. Develop alternative sourcing initiatives based on market opportunities and business requirements.

5. Monitor channel-wise performance and optimize sourcing strategies based on lead quality, site visits, bookings, and acquisition costs.

E. Site Visit Generation & Conversion Management

1. Work closely with the Brand & Marketing Head, Sales Team, and Telemarketing Team to convert sourced leads into qualified site visits and bookings.

2. Maintain a minimum 10% lead-to-walk-in ratio and 15% walk-in-to-booking ratio, as per organizational benchmarks.

3. Achieve an average booking conversion of 15% against the applicable assigned sourcing base, as defined in the approved business plan.

4. Track lead movement, follow-ups, site visit scheduling, actual walk-ins, bookings, and cancellations across all sourcing channels.

5. Identify conversion gaps and implement corrective action plans in coordination with the relevant teams.

6. Take proactive measures to minimize avoidable cancellations through timely follow-ups and customer coordination.

F. Budget & Cost Management

1. Ensure that referral benefits, loyalty incentives, employee and corporate benefits, activation expenses, and other sourcing-related costs remain within approved budgets.

2. Work closely with the Brand & Marketing Head, Finance, Vendor Management, and Strategy Teams to plan and monitor sourcing expenditure.

3. Track cost per lead, cost per site visit, cost per booking, and return on investment for each sourcing initiative.

4. Recommend measures to improve sourcing efficiency and maximize business contribution within approved cost parameters.

5. Ensure all benefits, incentives, and commercial commitments follow the organization's approval processes.

G. Payout Management & Operational Coordination

1. Coordinate with Finance and relevant internal teams to ensure accurate processing and timely settlement of approved referral benefits, loyalty rewards, and other eligible sourcing-related payouts.

2. Maintain proper documentation of referrals, lead registrations, eligibility, approvals, booking references, and payout status.

3. Resolve payout-related queries and discrepancies in coordination with the concerned teams.

4. Ensure compliance with approved payout policies, documentation requirements, and internal processes.

H. CRM, MIS & Performance Monitoring

1. Ensure disciplined usage of SFDC (Salesforce) for lead registration, source attribution, lead tracking, and booking updates.

2. Ensure accurate and timely recording of all sourcing activities and maintain reliable channel-wise data.

3. Prepare regular MIS reports covering lead generation, sourcing contribution, site visits, booking conversions, cancellations, expenditure, and program performance.

4. Review performance against monthly and quarterly targets and implement corrective measures wherever required.

5. Use data-driven insights to identify high-performing sourcing initiatives and improve overall business productivity.

I. Governance, Ethics & Compliance

1. Maintain high standards of ethics, integrity, transparency, and professional conduct across all sourcing activities.

2. Ensure adherence to organizational policies, approved benefits, documentation standards, and applicable compliance requirements.

3. Prevent unauthorized commitments, incorrect source attribution, payout irregularities, and conflicts of interest.

4. Maintain effective coordination with Marketing, Sales, Telemarketing, Finance, Vendor Management, and Strategy Teams.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Sourcing Contribution: Minimum 50% of the approved business plan through designated non-marketing-led sourcing channels.

- Lead-to-Walk-in Ratio: Minimum 10%.

- Walk-in-to-Booking Ratio: Minimum 15%.

- Booking Conversion: Average 15% against the defined sourcing base.

- Referral & Loyalty Programs: Achievement of assigned lead, walk-in, and booking targets.

- Employee & Corporate Sourcing: Achievement of approved sourcing targets.

- Outstation & NRI Sourcing: Achievement of assigned business contribution targets.

- Cost Efficiency: Sourcing expenditure maintained within approved budgets.

- Cancellation Management: Reduction in avoidable booking cancellations.

- CRM Compliance: Accurate and timely SFDC usage and source attribution.

- Payout Efficiency: Timely processing of eligible benefits and rewards.

- Reporting & Governance: Timely MIS submission and adherence to organizational policies.

4. Key Working Relationships

- Brand & Marketing Head

- Sales Team

- Telemarketing Team

- Finance Team

- Vendor Management Team

- Strategy and Business Planning Team

- Existing Customers and Referral Networks

- Corporate Organizations and Employee Networks

5. Role Expectations

The Assistant Manager is expected to demonstrate strong business ownership, relationship management, analytical capability, planning, and execution discipline. The role requires proactive identification of sourcing opportunities, close coordination with internal stakeholders, and regular engagement at project sites, including weekends when required.

Success in this role will be measured by sustainable alternative sourcing growth, achievement of assigned business targets, improved lead-to-site-visit and booking conversions, and cost-effective execution within approved budgets.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹70,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Commuter assistance
* Flexible schedule
* Food provided
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Lead Engineer - L3 Observability
description:
**Presidio, Where Teamwork and Innovation Shape the Future**  
At Presidio, we're at the forefront of a global technology revolution, transforming industries through cutting-edge digital solutions and next-generation AI. We empower businesses - and their internal customers - to achieve more through innovation, automation, and intelligent insights.

**The Role**

Level 3 Managed Service Engineer serves as the senior escalation point and technical authority for end-to-end observability across the environment. This role is responsible for resolving or driving resolution of highly complex incidents spanning application, infrastructure, network, and third-party dependencies, while owning observability strategy, Datadog architecture, monitoring standards, and continuous improvement. The engineer is expected to guide L1 and L2 engineers, lead root cause analysis and major incident reviews, and partner with cross-functional teams to improve detection, reduce noise, and strengthen operational resilience for both 3-tier and cloud-native applications.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the final escalation and technical authority for complex, cross-domain incidents involving application, infrastructure, network, and third-party dependencies.
* Own the end-to-end observability architecture and strategy in Datadog, including instrumentation standards, tagging strategy, dashboard governance, and monitor design principles.
* Lead root cause analysis for major/critical incidents and drive post-incident reviews, ensuring permanent fixes and preventive monitoring are implemented.
* Define and continuously improve monitoring coverage for new and existing services, including 3-tier applications, microservices, and cloud-native workloads.
* Design and govern SLOs/SLIs aligned to business-critical services, and advise application and platform teams on instrumentation best practices.
* Drive automation initiatives: Datadog-as-code (Terraform/API-based configuration management), auto-remediation workflows, and integration with CI/CD pipelines.
* Partner with application, infrastructure, network, and security teams to close monitoring gaps and reduce mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to resolve (MTTR).
* Own capacity planning and performance engineering insights derived from long-term observability data trends.
* Manage Datadog platform health: cost optimization, license/usage governance, data retention, and integration management.
* Mentor L1 and L2 engineers, review their RCA quality, and build enablement material (runbooks, training, best practices).
* Act as a key stakeholder in client governance calls, presenting trends, risks, and improvement roadmaps.
* Evaluate and pilot new Datadog features or complementary observability tools, and lead their rollout.
* Define escalation matrices and coordinate cross-team response during major outages.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* 6+ years of experience in Managed Services, SRE, or platform engineering roles, with at least 3 years of hands-on ownership of a Datadog (or equivalent) observability platform at scale.
* Expert-level knowledge of Datadog, including:
* Platform architecture: organization/team structuring, RBAC, tagging strategy, and multi-environment setups.
* APM: distributed tracing at scale, service dependency mapping, and instrumentation strategy across polyglot environments.
* Synthetics and RUM: designing comprehensive digital experience monitoring strategies tied to business KPIs.
* Log Management: pipeline architecture, log-based metrics, and cost/volume governance.
* SLOs, error budgets, and anomaly/forecast-based alerting at an advanced level.
* Deep understanding of infrastructure and cloud architecture: compute, containers, orchestration (Kubernetes), auto-scaling, and multi-cloud/hybrid environments.
* Deep understanding of networking: routing, load balancing, CDN, DNS, and complex connectivity troubleshooting across hybrid environments.
* Strong incident and problem management leadership experience, including major incident command and post-incident review facilitation.
* Experience defining and governing observability standards across multiple teams or business units.

**Application & Architecture Understanding (technology-agnostic)**

* Expert-level understanding of 3-tier and N-tier application architectures, including how failures cascade across presentation, application, and data layers.
* Expert-level understanding of cloud-native and distributed architectures: microservices, event-driven systems, service meshes, API gateways, and asynchronous messaging.
* Ability to advise application teams on observability best practices (instrumentation, tracing context propagation, structured logging) without needing to write code in a specific language.
* Strong grasp of resiliency and failure patterns (retries, circuit breakers, backpressure, caching, graceful degradation) and how to detect their failure modes through observability data.

**Good to Have**

* Datadog advanced/expert certifications, or equivalent recognized observability certifications.
* Strong scripting/automation background (Python, Terraform, or similar) for Datadog-as-code and custom tooling.
* Experience with FinOps or cost governance for observability tooling at scale.
* Exposure to multiple observability ecosystems (New Relic, Dynatrace, Splunk, Grafana/Prometheus, OpenTelemetry).
* Experience presenting to senior stakeholders or clients on observability maturity and roadmaps.

**Soft Skills**

* Strategic thinking with the ability to balance immediate incident needs against long-term platform health.
* Strong leadership and mentoring capability across L1/L2 engineers.
* Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
* Calm, decisive leadership during major incidents.
* Strong documentation and process-governance discipline.

**Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

**Work Details**

* **Level:** L3 (Senior/Lead, Managed Services)
* **Shift:** Primarily general shift, with on-call responsibility for major incident escalations
* **Reporting To:** Observability Practice Lead / Delivery Manager

  

**Your future at Presidio**  
Joining Presidio means stepping into a culture of trailblazers - thinkers, builders, and collaborators - who push the boundaries of what's possible. With our expertise AI-driven analytics, cloud solutions, cybersecurity, and next-gen infrastructure, we enable businesses to stay ahead in an ever-evolving digital world.

Here, your impact is real. Whether you're harnessing the power of Generative AI, architecting resilient digital ecosystems, or driving data-driven transformation, you'll be part of a team that is shaping the future.

**Ready to innovate? Let's redefine what's next-together.**

  

**About Presidio**  
Presidio is committed to hiring the most qualified candidates to join our amazing culture. We aim to attract and hire top talent from all backgrounds, including underrepresented and marginalized communities. We encourage women, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans to apply for open roles at Presidio. Diversity of skills and thought is a key component to our business success.

title: Analyst - Order management
description:
Company Profile:
**Lennox (NYSE: LII)** Driven by 130 years of legacy, HVAC and refrigeration success, Lennox provides our residential and commercial customers with industry\-leading climate\-control solutions. At Lennox, we win as a team, aiming for excellence and delivering innovative, sustainable products and services. Our culture guides us and creates a workplace where all employees feel heard and welcomed. Lennox is a global community that values each team member’s contributions and offers a supportive environment for career development. Come, stay, and grow with us.
Job Description:
**Customer Support \& Communication:**

* Manage customer service requests including order status updates, acknowledgment requests, and invoice requests via phone and email.
* Manage a high volume of Supply Chain and internal stakeholder communications
* Collaborate with the appropriate level of customer support to resolve challenging inquiries and complaints, ensuring clear documentation and ongoing communication with the customer throughout the process.
* Serve as the primary or secondary point of contact for customer support needs, ensuring a high level of service and responsiveness.

**Order Management \& Processing:**

* Accurately process orders, including material numbers, quantities, and pricing, while resolving line holds due to pricing discrepancies or missing pricing information.
* Conduct research on part numbers to ensure accurate order processing and resolve product related issues.
* Review open orders for On Time In Full (OTIF) compliance and coordinate with production or supply chain teams to ensure execution.
* Assist sales representatives with order placement, status updates, inventory lookups, and customer related concerns.
* Provide technical support for part search and pricing inquiries.
* Returns, Credits \& Issue Resolution:
* Submit and manage credit and return requests related to concealed damages, shortages, carrier damages, pricing disputes, and other customer reported discrepancies.
* Work with internal stakeholders to minimize and resolve customer deductions without resolution.

 **Systems, Documentation \& Reporting:*** Maintain accurate records of all internal and external interactions in SAP.
* Ensure consistent adherence to department policies, procedures, and documentation standards.
* Maintain oversight of order related data accuracy to support reporting and operational visibility.

**Process Improvement \& Collaboration:*** Propose and support new processes that drive continuous improvement and reduce inefficiencies.
* Identify and communicate areas for process improvement to management.
* Support order management team goals and initiatives to strengthen a proactive customer support model.
* Work cross functionally with Planning, Logistics, Transportation, Brokers/Carriers, Supply Chain, Exports, Accounting, and other departments to ensure customer requirements are met.
* Contribute to the development of a centralized customer service HUB for order tracking and management.

**Additional Responsibilities:*** Perform other duties and tasks as assigned by the manager to support departmental and organizational goals.
* Adapt to evolving job requirements and contribute to special projects or cross functional initiatives as needed.


Qualifications:
* **4 to 6 years of experience** in Order Management or related roles.
* Experience working with SAP
* Any Graduate / bachelor’s degree

title: Lead Key Account Manager Govt
description:
### **Why join Stryker?**


Looking for a place that values your unique talents? Discover Stryker's award\-winning culture.  

We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.### **Job description**


We are excited to be named one of the World’s Best Workplaces by Fortune Magazine!
  

We are proud to offer you our total rewards package which includes bonuses, healthcare, insurance benefits, retirement programs, wellness programs, as well as service and performance awards – not to mention various social and recreational activities, all of which are location specific.  

### **What You Will Do**

* Own and grow Stryker's Government business across **Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, and Kerala**, delivering sustainable revenue growth and achieving sales targets.
* Develop and execute strategic account plans for key Government institutions, Medical Colleges, and Group Purchasing Organizations (GPOs).
* Manage the complete **Tender\-to\-Cash lifecycle**, including tender identification, pre\-bid activities, technical and commercial submissions, order management, installation, and payment collection.
* Drive business through **GeM Portal, State E\-Procurement Platforms, Rate Contracts, DME/DHS, and Central Government procurement channels**.
* Build and strengthen relationships with key stakeholders including Deans, Medical Superintendents, HoDs, Biomedical Engineers, Procurement Leaders, and Finance Heads.
* Identify, develop, and convert new business opportunities within Government healthcare institutions to increase market share and account penetration.
* Lead strategic discussions, product presentations, and business reviews with senior Government officials and institutional leadership teams.
* Partner with cross\-functional teams including Sales, Marketing, Service, Clinical, Finance, and Legal to deliver customer\-centric solutions.
* Drive product adoption, solution selling, and customer value creation by understanding institutional needs and aligning Stryker's portfolio accordingly.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for Government Key Accounts, ensuring high customer satisfaction, long\-term partnerships, and business retention.

### **What You Need**

* **5 to 9 years of experience** in Government Institutional Sales, Key Account Management, or Business Development within the Medical Device, MedTech, Healthcare, or Pharma industry.
* Proven success managing Government healthcare accounts across **Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, and Kerala**.
* Hands\-on experience with **Government Tenders, GeM, Rate Contracts, DME/DHS, AIIMS, ESIC, Railways, Defence, and other Central/State Government institutions**.
* Strong expertise in strategic account management, stakeholder engagement, negotiation, business planning, and payment collection.
* Bachelor's degree in Science, Pharmacy, Biomedical Engineering, or a related discipline; **MBA preferred**.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior decision\-makers, build long\-term partnerships, and drive growth in complex Government healthcare environments.

Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.

title: Manager, Corporate Strategy
description:
**The Company**


PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.


We operate a global, two\-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third\-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.


We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to engage in cross\-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross\-border trade.
